dialog.submit: Current hook closes dialog then starts creation; keep app-level feedback.

limitations: Paper nodes are editable static groups, not linked component instances.
Fixed artboard geometry is a reference; implement responsive flex/grid, not exported absolute positioning.
Behavior specifications need runtime keyboard, screen reader, reduced-motion, loading/error and resize verification.
Native desktop is the primary target; 390px mobile screens are adaptation references.
SVGs and guide screenshots are assets; never flatten interactive UI into images.

originalExtraction.state: Working tree including pre-existing uncommitted changes; extraction was not an immutable commit snapshot.

verification.scope: Visual review of changed sections and representative primitives, inspector, settings, workspace and turns; runtime interactions are not implemented by this handoff.
